results.headline: HydrogenPro ASA – Third quarter 2026 results ...
results.key_quote: Given the Company's liquidity position and the need to secure additional funding in the short to near term, the Board is continuing to evaluate alternative financing measures
results.summary: HydrogenPro reported significantly deteriorating Q3 2026 results with revenues down 53% QoQ (NOK 7m vs NOK 15m), gross profit collapsed 87% QoQ (NOK 3m vs NOK 24m), and EBITDA worsening to NOK -30m from NOK -16m. The company faces a critical liquidity crisis with cash declining sharply to NOK 27m and requiring immediate financing. The commercial pipeline remains stalled with no firm orders converted, as final investment decisions are pending and project timelines continue to extend due to regulatory uncertainty and technology verification processes. The company is in strategic review exploring financing alternatives that have not yet yielded results. Going concern risks are explicitly flagged. This represents a material deterioration from expectations, with the company clearly struggling operationally and financially.

results.headline: Wise Group plc H1 FY27 Results
results.key_quote: More than 16 million people and businesses used Wise in the past six months. These customers moved $141 billion across borders, up 24% year on year.
results.summary: Wise delivered ahead of expectations with strong growth across key metrics. Active customers grew 21% YoY to 16.2m, cross-border volume increased 24% YoY to $141b, and net revenue grew 23% YoY to $1,453.1m. The company expanded infrastructure, launched new products globally, and secured major bank partnerships. While cross-border take rate decreased slightly (by 2 bps to 0.50%), this was a proactive investment decision to strengthen competitive advantage. Card revenue grew 43% YoY and other revenue grew 27% YoY, demonstrating earnings diversification. Customer holdings increased 28% YoY to $43.5b. No explicit guidance changes were stated, but the strong operational performance and multiple strategic achievements (ninth direct connection, major bank partnerships, product launches) indicate the company is performing well relative to expectations.

Transaction efficiency with 12% decrease in transaction expenses

results.headline: Audited Results for the year ended 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: This has been an incredibly busy period for the Company which has seen us deliver some very significant milestones...Helium One have transitioned from an exploration company into a company with production in the US and a world class development project in Tanzania
results.summary: Helium One has delivered significant operational progress across both projects. In Tanzania, the Southern Rukwa Project achieved a six-fold increase in flow rates compared with 2024, sustained helium concentrations of 5.4% (air corrected), and secured Tanzania's first helium mining licence. In the US, the Galactica-Pegasus project achieved first gas in December 2025, commissioned the Piñon Canyon facility with six wells tied in, and achieved first helium sales in July 2026. The company reduced losses year-on-year (US$3.4m vs US$4.9m) and increased net assets to US$67.9m from US$53.2m. While no explicit prior guidance is stated for comparison, the delivery of major production milestones (first gas, first sales, ESP testing successes, mining licence award) suggests execution ahead of exploration-stage expectations, with the transition from explorer to producer representing material progress.
metrics_ahead: Six-fold increase in flow rates versus 2024 Extended Well Test
Sustained helium concentrations of 5.4% achieved at surface
Successfully transitioned from exploration to production company
First gas achieved and first sales commenced in US operations

However, the results show no comparison to external expectations or guidance, with explicit underperformance noted in development activity.
